description: The chart illustrates the evaluation results of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), on various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists eight datasets and metrics, namely GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, while the vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each dataset is associated with a pair of bars, with LLaMA-3-8B-it represented by a blue bar and Ours (Iterative RLHF) by an orange bar. The scores for LLaMA-3-8B-it range from approximately 20 for Chat-Arena-Hard to 79 for GSM-8K, while Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores range from around 20 for Chat-Arena-Hard to 79 for GSM-8K. The bars are grouped by dataset, with the two models compared side by side for each dataset. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized. Overall, the chart provides a clear comparison of the performance of the two models across different benchmarks.
